posts.text: Agree. Newspapers should also have more fun. Take the news seriously but yourself. Newspapers are supposed to be fun to read. People bitching about Wordle are morons. De Tocqueville was right: newspapers are the backbone of association and community. That means hard news and crosswords, obituaries and funny pages. Newspapers should be as many things to as many people as possible.
posts.summary: Newspapers should balance serious news with entertainment and community function

posts.text:
Aide bursts into boss’s office: “Mr. Roberts! People are calling JD Vance a crackpot for his views on the dollar! We need reinforcements with unimpeachable credibility! Who do we have?”

Roberts, sighs. Picks up phone: “Get me….Ron Paul!”
posts.summary: Mocks JD Vance dollar criticism by invoking Ron Paul
